description: Final Check: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Two raiders are going to approach the {base}. A frigate flies with you. Use everything you have learned: lock, aim at the diamond, fire, and keep the frigate alive.
success: The raiders are gone and the frigate is whole. {client} signs you off.
failure: The frigate is lost. We will go over it again.
radio-frigate: Pell: A frigate has joined you. She is on your side and a good deal tougher than you are. Stay near her.
Pell: Frigate on your wing. Let her draw fire if she can.
radio-raiders: Pell: Two raiders ahead. T, aim, fire. You know how.
Pell: Here they come. Everything we have covered, in one go. I will keep quiet.
